title: A-A crowd at rest, up to 8 particles, T <= 1: the P-0027 pair table summed pairwise predicts positions to 0.007

claims.statement: Up to 8 A particles, all at rest, with every initial pairwise distance in [3, 9], observed for at most T = 1.0: each particle accelerates toward each other particle with magnitude K(r)/r^2.5, where r is the separation and K(r) is the piecewise-linear table of P-0027 (nodes 3 to 9); the accelerations add, and the chamber walls reflect elastically. Measured positions are predicted to a judged RMSE of 0.007 of the chamber side. Evidence is one regular 8-particle ring (3x3 grid minus centre, spacing 3.1) and its replicate, at N = 8 only. Not claimed: any N below 8 (in the stated domain but untested), T above 1.0, initial velocities, species B or C, or a K(r) accurate to 2 percent at separations 3 to 5 (see P-0027 limits).
